newsitem.title: USA: S&P revises midcap, small cap indices.
newsitem.headline: S&P revises midcap, small cap indices.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday that it is revising its S&P MidCap 400 and S&P SmallCap 600 indices, due to pending mergers.
SpeedFam International Inc will replace Collective Bancorp Inc in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index after the close of trading on July 31, 1997, Standard & Poor's said in a statement.
Collective Bancorp is being acquired by S&P MidCap 400 component Summit Bancorp in a stock transaction scheduled to close at that time.

Duty Free International Inc will be replaced in the S&P MidCap 400 Index after the close of trading on August 5, 1997, by Corrections Corp of America, currently a component of the S&P SmallCap 600 Index, Standard & Poor's said. Duty Free International is being acquired by the Britain's BAA Plc.
Billing Concepts Corp will replace Corrections Corp in the SmallCap 600 Index, Standard & Poor's said.
Executive Risk Inc will replace Wyle Electronics, which is being acquired by Germany's Raab Karcher AB, in the S&P SmallCap 600 after the close of trading on August 5.
